blocks.zh: 導論與一般程序
blocks.en: Introduction and General Procedures

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈61〉 的適用範圍：針對非無菌產品（Nonsterile Products）的微生物計數試驗
blocks.en: Understand the scope of USP <61>: microbial enumeration tests for nonsterile products

blocks.zh: 掌握「強制性章節」（mandatory chapter，編號 <1000）與「參考性章節」（informational chapter，編號 ≥1000）的區別
blocks.en: Distinguish a "mandatory chapter" (general chapter number below 1000) from an "informational chapter" (number 1000 or above)

blocks.zh: 了解三種計數方法（薄膜過濾法、平板計數法、MPN 法）的概觀與選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Get an overview of the three enumeration methods (membrane filtration, plate count, MPN) and the logic for choosing among them

blocks.zh: 理解一般程序中的核心要求：避免外來污染、去除/中和抑菌活性、界面活性劑相容性
blocks.en: Understand the core requirements of the general procedures: avoiding extrinsic contamination, removing/neutralizing antimicrobial activity, and surfactant compatibility

blocks.zh: 認識生長促進試驗（Growth Promotion Test）及計數方法適用性驗證的基本框架
blocks.en: Become familiar with the growth promotion test and the basic framework for suitability of the counting method

blocks.zh: 0.1 Introduction — 導論
blocks.en: 0.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: USP 〈61〉 的定位：這是一個強制性章節（General Chapter 編號 <1000），意味著當產品專論（monograph）引用此章節時，必須嚴格遵守。這與編號 ≥1000 的參考性章節（如 〈1111〉、〈1116〉）不同，後者僅提供指導性建議。
blocks.en: Positioning of USP <61>: This is a mandatory chapter (general chapter number below 1000), which means it must be followed strictly whenever a product monograph refers to it. This differs from informational chapters numbered 1000 or above (such as <1111> and <1116>), which only offer guidance.

blocks.zh: Mesophilic（中溫型）：指在 20–45°C 範圍內生長最佳的微生物。USP 〈61〉 的培養條件（30–35°C 給細菌、20–25°C 給黴菌酵母菌）正是針對這類微生物。它不會偵測到嗜熱菌（thermophiles）或嗜冷菌（psychrophiles）。
blocks.en: Mesophilic: Refers to microorganisms that grow best in the range of 20–45°C. The incubation conditions of USP <61> (30–35°C for bacteria, 20–25°C for yeasts and molds) target exactly this group. The method will not detect thermophiles or psychrophiles.

blocks.zh: Aerobic Conditions（好氧條件）：這些方法僅計數在有氧環境下生長的微生物。厭氧菌（anaerobes）不在此章節的偵測範圍內。
blocks.en: Aerobic Conditions: These methods count only microorganisms that grow in the presence of oxygen. Anaerobes are outside the scope of this chapter.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 餐廳衛生稽查的標準：
blocks.en: The standard for a restaurant hygiene inspection:

blocks.zh: 想像 USP 〈61〉 就像衛生局對餐廳的「標準衛生檢查表」。它不是要找出餐廳裡的每一隻蟲子（那需要更專門的檢測），而是用一套標準化的方法，檢查在「一般條件」下能發現的常見問題。如果餐廳通過了這個檢查，表示它的衛生狀況在可接受範圍內 — 但這不代表完全沒有問題。
blocks.en: Think of USP <61> as the health department's standard hygiene checklist for restaurants. It is not meant to find every bug in the restaurant (that would take more specialized testing); it uses a standardized method to check for the common problems that can be found under "ordinary conditions." If the restaurant passes, its hygiene is within an acceptable range, but that does not mean there are no problems at all.

blocks.zh: 同樣地，USP 〈61〉 用特定的培養條件偵測「常見的中溫好氧微生物」，而非所有可能存在的微生物。
blocks.en: In the same way, USP <61> uses defined incubation conditions to detect "common mesophilic aerobic microorganisms," not every microorganism that might be present.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 不適用於活菌產品：原文明確指出，含有「活性微生物作為有效成分」的產品不適用這些方法。這涵蓋了益生菌製劑、活菌疫苗等產品。因為這些產品本身就含有大量活菌，用標準計數方法無法區分「產品菌」和「污染菌」。
blocks.en: Not applicable to live-organism products: The original text states explicitly that products containing "live microorganisms as active ingredients" are not covered by these methods. This includes probiotic preparations, live vaccines and similar products. Because such products contain large numbers of live organisms by design, a standard counting method cannot distinguish the "product organisms" from "contaminants."

blocks.zh: 替代方法的開放性：USP 允許使用替代方法（包括快速微生物檢測法 RMM），但前提是必須證明其與藥典方法等效（equivalence）。這對 CDMO 而言是一個重要的技術升級機會 — 例如使用即時微生物偵測技術可以大幅縮短放行時間。
blocks.en: Openness to alternative methods: USP allows alternative methods (including rapid microbiological methods, RMM), provided they are shown to be equivalent to the pharmacopeial method. For a CDMO this is a significant opportunity to upgrade technology; for example, real-time microbial detection can shorten release times substantially.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Industry Application
blocks.en: CDMO Industry Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：作為受託製造機構，USP 〈61〉 影響你的以下操作：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: As a contract manufacturer, USP <61> affects the following operations:

blocks.zh: 原料入庫檢驗 — 非無菌原料（如賦形劑、某些 API）需依此章節檢測微生物負載（bioburden）
blocks.en: Incoming raw material testing — Nonsterile raw materials (such as excipients and some APIs) are tested for bioburden according to this chapter

blocks.zh: 包材檢驗 — 橡膠塞、玻璃瓶等包裝材料在滅菌前的 bioburden 測試
blocks.en: Packaging material testing — Bioburden testing of packaging materials such as rubber stoppers and glass vials before sterilization

blocks.zh: 製程中監控 — 調配液在除菌過濾前的 bioburden 數據，作為過程控制指標
blocks.en: In-process monitoring — Bioburden data on the bulk solution before sterilizing filtration serve as a process control indicator

blocks.zh: 環境監測輔助 — 環境樣品中好氧菌/黴菌酵母菌的計數
blocks.en: Supporting environmental monitoring — Counting of aerobic bacteria and yeasts/molds in environmental samples

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: USP 〈61〉 為什麼選擇「中溫好氧」作為標準檢測條件？如果一種原料可能含有厭氧菌污染，你需要額外做什麼檢測？
blocks.en: Why does USP <61> choose "mesophilic aerobic" conditions as the standard test conditions? If a raw material might be contaminated with anaerobes, what additional testing would you need to do?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 想導入一套快速微生物檢測系統來替代傳統的平板計數法，根據 USP 〈61〉 的要求，你需要完成哪些驗證步驟？
blocks.en: If your CDMO wants to introduce a rapid microbiological method to replace the traditional plate count method, which validation steps must you complete according to USP <61>?

blocks.zh: 0.2 General Procedures — 一般程序
blocks.en: 0.2 General Procedures

blocks.zh: 三大程序原則：這段短短的文字，其實濃縮了微生物實驗室操作的三大核心原則：
blocks.en: Three principles of the procedure: This short passage condenses the three core principles of microbiology laboratory work:

blocks.zh: 原則一：無菌操作 — 避免外來污染（extrinsic contamination）。在生物安全櫃（BSC）或層流工作台中操作，確保你測到的微生物來自產品本身，而非操作過程引入的。
blocks.en: Principle 1: Aseptic technique — Avoid extrinsic contamination. Work in a biological safety cabinet (BSC) or laminar flow workstation so that the microorganisms you detect come from the product itself and not from the handling process.

blocks.zh: 原則二：中和抑菌活性 — 很多藥品本身含有防腐劑（如 parabens）、抗菌劑或其他抑菌成分。如果不中和這些活性，微生物會在測試中被殺死或抑制，導致假陰性結果（false negative）。
blocks.en: Principle 2: Neutralize antimicrobial activity — Many drug products contain preservatives (such as parabens), antimicrobial agents or other inhibitory components. If this activity is not neutralized, microorganisms are killed or inhibited during the test, leading to false negative results.

blocks.zh: 原則三：界面活性劑安全性 — 用來幫助樣品分散的界面活性劑（如 polysorbate 80）本身不能對微生物產生毒性，且要與中和劑相容。
blocks.en: Principle 3: Surfactant safety — A surfactant used to help disperse the sample (such as polysorbate 80) must itself be non-toxic to microorganisms and must be compatible with the neutralizing agent.

blocks.zh: 犯罪現場鑑識的規則：
blocks.en: Rules of crime scene forensics:

blocks.zh: 微生物計數就像犯罪現場鑑識（forensic investigation）。你需要確保：
blocks.en: Microbial enumeration is like a forensic investigation of a crime scene. You need to make sure that you:

blocks.zh: 不帶入新指紋（避免外來污染）— 鑑識人員戴手套、穿防護衣
blocks.en: Do not introduce new fingerprints (avoid extrinsic contamination) — investigators wear gloves and protective suits

blocks.zh: 不破壞現有證據（中和抑菌活性）— 如果現場有化學物質會分解指紋，你需要先中和它
blocks.en: Do not destroy existing evidence (neutralize antimicrobial activity) — if a chemical at the scene would degrade fingerprints, you must neutralize it first

blocks.zh: 採集工具不干擾證據（界面活性劑無毒性）— 你的採集拭子不能含有會破壞 DNA 的物質
blocks.en: Use collection tools that do not interfere with the evidence (non-toxic surfactant) — your collection swab must not contain substances that destroy DNA

blocks.zh: 任何一個環節出問題，你得到的「偵查結果」就不可靠。
blocks.en: If any one of these steps goes wrong, the "findings" of the investigation are unreliable.

blocks.zh: 「必須證明」的雙重驗證：注意原文對中和劑的要求是雙重的 — 不僅要證明它能有效中和抑菌活性（efficacy），還要證明它對微生物無毒性（absence of toxicity）。這意味著中和劑本身不能殺菌或抑菌。
blocks.en: The twofold demonstration of "must be shown": Note that the requirement for the neutralizing agent is twofold. You must demonstrate not only that it effectively neutralizes the antimicrobial activity (efficacy) but also that it is non-toxic to microorganisms (absence of toxicity). In other words, the neutralizing agent itself must not kill or inhibit microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 舉例：如果你用 lecithin 來中和產品中的 parabens，你需要同時驗證：(1) lecithin 確實能有效中和 parabens 的抑菌活性；(2) lecithin 本身不會抑制或殺死測試微生物。
blocks.en: Example: If you use lecithin to neutralize the parabens in a product, you need to verify both that (1) lecithin effectively neutralizes the antimicrobial activity of the parabens, and (2) lecithin itself does not inhibit or kill the test microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，哪些常見的藥品賦形劑具有抑菌活性，需要在 USP 〈61〉 測試前進行中和？
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, which common pharmaceutical excipients have antimicrobial activity and need to be neutralized before USP <61> testing?

blocks.zh: 如果一個產品含有高濃度的防腐劑，且你找不到有效的中和方法，USP 〈61〉 允許你怎麼做？（提示：參考後面的「稀釋法」）
blocks.en: If a product contains a high concentration of preservative and you cannot find an effective neutralization method, what does USP <61> allow you to do? (Hint: see the dilution approach later on.)

blocks.zh: 0.3 Enumeration Methods — 計數方法概觀
blocks.en: 0.3 Enumeration Methods Overview

blocks.zh: 三種「點人數」的方法：
blocks.en: Three ways of "counting heads":

blocks.zh: 想像你要數一個大廣場上有多少人：
blocks.en: Imagine you need to count the people in a large square:

blocks.zh: 薄膜過濾法 = 讓所有人通過一個閘門，閘門會攔住每個人並逐一計數 — 最精確
blocks.en: Membrane filtration = everyone passes through a gate that stops each person and counts them one by one — the most precise

blocks.zh: 平板計數法 = 把人群分散到多個小區域，分別數每個區域的人數再加總 — 相當精確
blocks.en: Plate count = spread the crowd across several small areas, count each area and add up the totals — fairly precise

blocks.zh: MPN 法 = 把人群分成多組，只記錄「有人/沒人」，再用統計表推算總人數 — 是估算值，不夠精確
blocks.en: MPN method = split the crowd into several groups, record only "someone present / nobody present," and use a statistical table to estimate the total — an estimate, and less precise

blocks.zh: 方法適用性驗證是必要的：原文最後一句話是關鍵 — 「The suitability of the chosen method must be established.」無論你選擇哪種方法，都必須針對你的特定產品進行適用性驗證。這不是可選的，而是強制要求。
blocks.en: Suitability of the method must be established: The last sentence of the original text is the key: "The suitability of the chosen method must be established." Whichever method you choose, its suitability must be demonstrated for your specific product. This is not optional; it is a mandatory requirement.

blocks.zh: 足夠的樣品量：方法必須能檢測足夠的樣品量來判斷是否符合規格。如果一個產品的接受標準是 102 cfu/g，但你只能測試 0.001 g 的樣品，那你的方法靈敏度就不足以判斷合規性。
blocks.en: Sufficient sample amount: The method must be able to test a sample amount large enough to judge compliance with the specification. If a product's acceptance criterion is 102 cfu/g but you can only test 0.001 g of sample, the sensitivity of your method is not sufficient to judge compliance.

blocks.zh: 一個含有高濃度酒精（70% ethanol）的外用製劑，你會選擇哪種計數方法？為什麼？
blocks.en: For a topical preparation containing a high concentration of alcohol (70% ethanol), which enumeration method would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 說 MPN 法是「最不精確的」，但對於極低 bioburden 的產品卻可能是「最合適的」？這看似矛盾的說法背後的邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does USP describe the MPN method as "the least precise" yet possibly "the most appropriate" for products with extremely low bioburden? What is the logic behind this seemingly contradictory statement?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 三種計數方法比較
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Comparison of the Three Enumeration Methods

blocks.zh: 方法選擇的邏輯：優先考慮薄膜過濾法（精確度最高、可沖洗去除抑菌物質），次選平板計數法，MPN 法是最後手段。
blocks.en: Logic of method selection: Membrane filtration is preferred (highest precision, and inhibitory substances can be rinsed away), plate count is second choice, and the MPN method is the last resort.

blocks.zh: 0.4 Growth Promotion Test, Suitability & Negative Controls — 生長促進試驗、適用性與陰性對照（概觀）
blocks.en: 0.4 Growth Promotion Test, Suitability & Negative Controls (Overview)

blocks.zh: 「生長促進」與「方法適用性」是兩件不同的事：
blocks.en: "Growth promotion" and "method suitability" are two different things:

blocks.zh: Growth Promotion Test（生長促進試驗）：測試的是「培養基本身」的品質 — 這批培養基能不能正常讓微生物生長？相當於檢查你的「偵測器」是否正常運作。
blocks.en: Growth Promotion Test: This tests the quality of the "culture medium itself": can this batch of medium support normal microbial growth? It is equivalent to checking that your "detector" works properly.

blocks.zh: Suitability of the Counting Method（計數方法適用性）：測試的是「方法+產品」的組合 — 在產品存在的情況下，你選的方法能不能準確偵測到微生物？相當於檢查你的「偵測器在實際使用場景下」是否仍然可靠。
blocks.en: Suitability of the Counting Method: This tests the combination of "method + product": in the presence of the product, can the method you chose still detect microorganisms accurately? It is equivalent to checking that your "detector" is still reliable "under actual conditions of use."

blocks.zh: Seed-Lot System（種子批系統）：為了確保測試菌株的穩定性和一致性，USP 要求使用種子批系統，且接種用的菌株不超過 5 代（five passages from master seed-lot）。傳代次數過多會導致菌株特性漂移。
blocks.en: Seed-Lot System: To keep the test strains stable and consistent, USP requires a seed-lot system, and the strains used for inoculation must not be more than five passages from the master seed-lot. Too many passages cause the strain's characteristics to drift.

blocks.zh: 驗孕棒的品質管控：
blocks.en: Quality control of a pregnancy test strip:

blocks.zh: 生長促進試驗就像在使用驗孕棒之前先做品管：
blocks.en: The growth promotion test is like running quality control on a pregnancy test strip before using it:

blocks.zh: 生長促進 = 用已知的陽性樣品測試驗孕棒能不能正常顯示「兩條線」— 確認工具本身沒問題
blocks.en: Growth promotion = use a known positive sample to check that the strip shows "two lines" properly — confirms that the tool itself is fine

blocks.zh: 方法適用性 = 把陽性樣品混入待測樣品中，看驗孕棒在「真實使用條件下」能不能正確偵測 — 確認產品中的成分不會干擾測試結果
blocks.en: Method suitability = mix the positive sample into the sample to be tested and see whether the strip detects it correctly "under real conditions of use" — confirms that components of the product do not interfere with the test result

blocks.zh: 陰性對照 = 用純水測試驗孕棒不會出現假陽性 — 確認沒有來自操作環境的污染
blocks.en: Negative control = test the strip with pure water to make sure it gives no false positive — confirms that there is no contamination from the working environment

blocks.zh: 「Must be established」— 強制性語言：注意 USP 用的是 "must"，不是 "should" 或 "may"。這代表方法適用性驗證是強制要求，不是建議。
blocks.en: "Must be established" — mandatory language: Note that USP uses "must," not "should" or "may." This means that demonstrating method suitability is a mandatory requirement, not a recommendation.

blocks.zh: 何時需要重新驗證：原文指出兩種情況需要重新確認適用性：(1) 測試執行方式有變更；(2) 產品配方有變更且可能影響測試結果。在 CDMO 場景中，這特別重要 — 每次接到新客戶的產品或現有產品配方變更時，都需要重新做方法適用性驗證。
blocks.en: When revalidation is needed: The original text identifies two situations that require suitability to be confirmed again: (1) a change in how the test is performed, and (2) a change in the product formulation that may affect the test result. In a CDMO this is especially important: method suitability must be repeated every time a new client's product is received or an existing product's formulation changes.

blocks.zh: 陰性對照失敗 = 必須調查：如果陰性對照出現微生物生長，代表測試環境可能被污染，所有同批次的測試結果都不可信。這需要啟動正式的偏差調查。
blocks.en: Negative control failure = investigation required: If microorganisms grow in the negative control, the test environment may be contaminated and all test results from the same batch are unreliable. A formal deviation investigation must be initiated.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 剛接到一個新客戶的產品（含 0.1% benzalkonium chloride 作為防腐劑）。在進行 USP 〈61〉 測試之前，你需要完成哪些前置驗證工作？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has just received a new client's product containing 0.1% benzalkonium chloride as a preservative. What preliminary validation work must you complete before performing USP <61> testing?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 要限制測試菌株的傳代次數不超過 5 代？如果你使用了第 8 代的 S. aureus，可能會發生什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does USP limit the test strains to no more than five passages? What problems could arise if you used a passage 8 culture of S. aureus?

blocks.zh: 你的實驗室連續三次陰性對照失敗，你會從哪些方面展開調查？（提示：人、機、料、法、環）
blocks.en: Your laboratory has had three consecutive negative control failures. Which areas would you examine in the investigation? (Hint: man, machine, material, method, environment.)

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP 〈61〉 是強制性章節（編號 <1000），定義了非無菌產品中中溫好氧菌和黴菌/酵母菌的定量計數方法
blocks.en: USP <61> is a mandatory chapter (number below 1000) that defines quantitative enumeration methods for mesophilic aerobic bacteria and molds/yeasts in nonsterile products

blocks.zh: 三種計數方法：薄膜過濾法（首選）、平板計數法（pour-plate 或 surface-spread）、MPN 法（最後手段）
blocks.en: Three enumeration methods: membrane filtration (first choice), plate count (pour-plate or surface-spread), and the MPN method (last resort)

blocks.zh: 一般程序三原則：避免外來污染、中和抑菌活性、確認界面活性劑無毒性
blocks.en: Three general principles: avoid extrinsic contamination, neutralize antimicrobial activity, and confirm that surfactants are non-toxic

blocks.zh: 兩層驗證：生長促進試驗（驗證培養基品質）+ 方法適用性驗證（驗證方法在產品存在下的偵測能力）
blocks.en: Two layers of verification: the growth promotion test (verifies medium quality) plus method suitability (verifies the method's ability to detect microorganisms in the presence of the product)

blocks.zh: 陰性對照是必要的品質保證步驟，失敗時必須啟動調查
blocks.en: Negative controls are a required quality assurance step, and a failure must trigger an investigation

blocks.zh: CDMO 影響：原料入庫、包材測試、製程中 bioburden 監控都需遵循此章節
blocks.en: Impact on a CDMO: incoming raw materials, packaging material testing and in-process bioburden monitoring must all follow this chapter
